cass-crv-sales-2024.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon; direct geojson query (CRV joined layers support neither returnIdsOnly nor resultOffset paging)
cass-crv-sales-2024.geojson.caveats: Certificate of Real Estate Value sales for 2024 (parcel polygons). FENCE: buyer/seller names, submitter name, phone, organisation, EMV/valuation fields (LAND_EST/BUILDING/LMV/EMV_WORK), mortgage and payment fields were NOT requested or stored. Purchase price + sale date ARE stored (public-record sale facts, the substance of the change/turnover layer); the wire-in may drop price if the parcel fence is applied strictly. Sale dates are stored as YYYYMMDD numbers. FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
